raw_segments.text: Not far from thence, the mournful fields appear so-called from lovers that inhabit there.
The souls whom that unhappy flame invades, in secret solitude and myrtle shades make
endless moans, and pining with desire lament too late their unextinguished fire.
Here progress, aerophile here he found, bearing her breast, yet bleeding with the wound made
by her son.
He saw pacify there with Phaedra's ghost, a foul incestuous pair.
Their laodamia, with a vadny, moves, unhappy both, but loyal in their loves.
Kenius, a woman once, and once a man, but ending in the sex she first began.
Not far from these Phoenician Dido stood, fresh from her wound, her bosom bathed in blood,
whom, when the Trojan hero hardly knew, obscure in shades and with a doubtful view,
doubtful as he who sees through dusky night or thinks he sees the moon's uncertain light,
with tears he first approached the sullen shade.
And as his love inspeared him thus he said,
Unhappy Queen, then is the common breath of rumour true in your reported death,
and I alas, the cause.
By heave and I vow, and all the powers that rule the realms below, unwilling I forsook
your friendly state, commanded by the gods and forked by fate.
Those gods that fate, whose unresistant might have sent me to these regions void of light,
throw the vast empire of eternal night.
Nor dard I to presume that, pressed with grief, my flight should urge you to this dire relief.
Stay, stay your steps, and listen to my vows.
Tease the last interview that fate allows.
In vain he thus attempts her mind to move with tears and prayers and late repenting love.
Distainfully she looked, then turning round, but fixed her eyes unmoved upon the ground,
and what he says and swears regards no more than the deaf rocks when the loud billows roar,
but whirled away to shun his hateful sight, hid in the forest and the shades of night,
then sought sickiest throw the shady grove, who answered all her cares and equalled all her love.
